Software Engineer - AI Hub

Bangalore, Karnataka, India | req32733

  • In this role you will design and develop scalable business applications that deliver outstanding user experiences
  • Further you will build secure and reliable solutions across user interface, server-side services and databases
  • Furthermore,, you will translate business requirements into practical digital solutions that create measurable value
  • Moreover, you will develop and maintain application interfaces that connect enterprise systems and platforms
  • Further, you will create cloud-based solutions using Microsoft Azure services and modern development technologies
  • Thereafter, you will ensure high levels of application performance, security, quality and reliability
  • Furthermore, you will drive continuous improvement through automated testing, deployment and monitoring practices
  • Moreover, you will troubleshoot complex technical challenges and deliver sustainable long-term solutions
  • Further, you will collaborate closely with product owners, business analysts, designers and architects to deliver successful outcomes
  • Additionally, you will contribute to the evolution of digital platforms and help shape the future of business applications across Linde
